title: 茶水间英文 - 11月14日 | 全美航班停摆、星舰冲上天、波帅入主曼联
description:
A nationwide ground stop grounded every departing flight in the United States on Friday after the FAA's aging air traffic system overloaded, stranding millions of travelers and cancelling more than six thousand flights. Meanwhile SpaceX's Starship reached orbit but lost its booster in a fireball, and Mauricio Pochettino left the US national team to rescue Manchester United. Plus a random question: if you could swap jobs with anyone for one day, whose job would you steal?

周五下午，美国联邦航空局下令全国停飞，原因是老旧的空管系统数据过载，六千多架次航班取消、数百万旅客滞留。与此同时，SpaceX 星舰成功入轨却没能接住助推器，波切蒂诺则离开美国国家队、火速接手深陷降级区的曼联。今天还有一个随机问题：如果你能和任何人换一天工作，你会选谁？

Words to steal 生词本：
- ground stop — 停飞令；全面停飞
- overloaded — 超载；不堪重负
- floppy disk — 软盘
- ripple into — 波及；连锁影响到
- chopsticks — （星舰回收的）机械臂
- abort — 中止；取消
- release clause — 解约条款
- relegation zone — 降级区
